test_plan.description: Structural assertions (flake-parts wiring, ./flake imports, module files exist, flake-utils gone from root lock refs) — fails on the pre-change flake, proving the change happened.
Full output equivalence vs baseline-outputs.json (reruns the capture script against the new flake and diffs).

Scoped: x86_64 checks built green locally in 4.9s (evidence/t3-x86-checks.txt). Full unscoped nix flake check was aborted: its aarch64 half requires first-time QEMU-emulated Rust builds on this x86_64 host (no aarch64 remote builder configured), which dominated runtime; aarch64 checks are eval-proven (attrNames, drv existence in post-outputs.json) and build-natively pending on mikki-laptop. Remote builders are skipped for these trivial runCommands by design (~100x round-trip overhead measured).
